questions.question: What is another name for the service line?
questions.explanation: The trailer service air line is also called the control line or signal line.

questions.question: When driving a tractor-trailer with ABS, you should:

options.text: Use extra braking force to make the ABS work.
Brake using less pressure than normal.

questions.explanation: Brake the same way you would in a vehicle without ABS.

questions.question: When inspecting a coupling, you should go under the trailer and:

options.text: Detach the jaws from the kingpin.
Make sure the locking lever is in the "emergency" position.
Look into the back of the fifth wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look into the back of the fifth wheel.
questions.explanation: Look into the back of the fifth wheel. Make sure the jaws are locked around the kingpin.

questions.question: Rollovers happen when:

options.text: A truck driver is driving too fast.
The vehicle in front is moving too slowly.
A truck driver is driving too slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: A truck driver is driving too fast.
questions.explanation: Rollovers happen when a vehicle is driven too fast. To reduce rollover risk, load cargo low to the ground and take turns and curves slowly.

questions.question: Using the trailer hand brake during a trailer jackknife will:
questions.explanation: Release the brakes to help your tires regain traction. Using the trailer hand brake during a skid will make the skid continue.

questions.question: Emergency air lines are often coded with the color:
questions.explanation: Service air lines are coded blue. Emergency air lines are coded red.

questions.question: If oil and water build up in your air tanks, the brakes:
questions.explanation: Drain air tanks daily to remove water and oil. Too much oil and water can damage the brakes.

questions.question: What is another name for the service line?
questions.explanation: The trailer service air line is also called the control line or signal line.

questions.question: What does the tractor protection valve do?

options.text: Protects the tractor from being stolen
Protects the tractor from exceeding a set speed
Keeps air in the braking system if the trailer breaks away or leaks

questions.correctAnswerText: Keeps air in the braking system if the trailer breaks away or leaks
questions.explanation: The tractor protection valve keeps air in the tractor braking system if the trailer breaks away or develops a leak.

questions.question: If the trailer begins to skid, you should:

options.text: Quickly turn the steering wheel one way, then the other.

questions.explanation: Release the brakes to help the wheels grip the road again. Once traction returns, the trailer will straighten out and follow the tractor.

questions.question: How should you prevent a trailer from rolling over?

options.text: Speed up when nearing a corner.
Take on-ramps faster than the posted speed limit.

questions.explanation: To prevent a rollover when driving a combination vehicle, keep cargo weight as low to the ground as possible and drive slowly around turns.

questions.question: If a trailer starts to jackknife, which action should you NOT take?

options.text: Allow the wheels to grip the road.
Allow the trailer to straighten out.

questions.explanation: If a trailer jackknifes, release the brakes and let the trailer wheels regain traction. Do not apply the trailer hand brake because it will only make the skid worse. Brakes caused the wheels to lock in the first place.

questions.question: How can you check if a trailer has ABS if you are not sure?

options.text: Check under the trailer for wheel speed sensors coming from the back of the brakes.
Try driving on a slippery surface and see if ABS kicks in.
Remove a tire and look for the ABS sensor on the axle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check under the trailer for wheel speed sensors coming from the back of the brakes.
questions.explanation: Trailers and converter dollies made after March 1, 1998 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS). A yellow warning light will show if ABS is present. For older trailers, check under the trailer for wires and sensors coming from the back of the brakes.

questions.question: When does the automatic tractor protection valve pop out?

options.text: When air pressure drops to between 20 and 45 psi.
When you are experiencing a trailer jackknife.
When wheels have regained traction after a skid.
When air pressure is above 45 psi.

questions.correctAnswerText: When air pressure drops to between 20 and 45 psi.
questions.explanation: The automatic tractor protection valve pops out when air pressure drops to between 20 and 45 psi. When it pops out, the valve closes and stops air flow.

questions.question: When trailer air lines use color codes, what color marks emergency lines?
questions.explanation: When trailer air lines are color-coded, service lines are blue and emergency lines are red.

questions.question: Driving a combination vehicle ____ driving a single vehicle.

options.text: is safer in bad weather than

questions.explanation: Driving a combination vehicle requires more skill than driving a single vehicle. Combination vehicles are longer and heavier.

questions.question: Why is proper coupling technique important?

options.text: It is the same on all vehicles.
It is essential for safe vehicle operation.
It means the fifth wheel plate should not be greased.
It can be learned over time.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is essential for safe vehicle operation.
questions.explanation: Proper coupling and uncoupling technique is critical for safe combination vehicle operation. Improper coupling is very dangerous.

questions.question: What is a bobtail?

options.text: A tractor that exceeds the speed limit
A tractor that drives below the speed limit

questions.explanation: A bobtail tractor is a tractor without a semi-trailer. Drivers must use extra caution when operating a bobtail tractor.

questions.question: What do you test by pulling out the trailer air supply control?
questions.explanation: Test the trailer emergency brakes before starting a trip. After making sure the trailer rolls freely, pull out the trailer air supply control or move it to "emergency." Pull forward slightly and check that the trailer does not move.

questions.question: What is the best way to notice that your trailer is skidding?
questions.explanation: The earliest and best way to notice a trailer skid is to see the trailer move off-course in your mirrors.
